interview.privacy: Jawaabahaaga waxaa loo dirayaa adeeg AI ah oo bilaash ah si laguu siiyo talooyin. Ha qorin magacaaga, lambarka taleefanka, cinwaanka, lambarrada aqoonsiga ama faahfaahin kale oo shakhsi ah — khibraddaada si guud u sharax.
